System Architecture

Introduction

The User Access Control application follows a modular architecture. The application separates authentication, authorization, database operations, security, and utility functions into different Python modules.

Application Structure

The project contains the following main components:

UserAccessControl/
|
+-- app/
|   |
|   +-- main.py
|   +-- auth.py
|   +-- access.py
|   +-- db.py
|   +-- security.py
|   +-- utils.py
|   |
|   +-- html/
|   |   +-- login.html
|   |   +-- home.html
|   |   +-- denied.html
|   |   +-- page1.html
|   |   +-- page2.html
|   |   +-- page3.html
|   |   +-- page4.html
|   |
|   +-- static/
|
+-- docs/
    +-- source/
    +-- build/

Main Components

main.py

The main application module creates the FastAPI application, configures session middleware, mounts static files, initializes the database, and registers application routes.

auth.py

This module handles user authentication, including login and logout functionality.

access.py

This module manages user-specific page permissions and controls access to protected pages.

db.py

This module handles database connectivity and database-related operations.

security.py

This module contains security-related functionality, such as password hashing and password verification.

utils.py

This module contains reusable helper functions used by the application.

Authentication and Authorization Flow

The application follows this general workflow:

  1. The user opens the login page.

  2. The user submits their username and password.

  3. The application verifies the credentials.

  4. After successful authentication, a user session is created.

  5. The user opens a protected page.

  6. The application checks the user’s page permissions.

  7. If permission is granted, the requested page is displayed.

  8. Otherwise, the access denied page is displayed.

Conclusion

The modular architecture makes the application easier to understand, maintain, test, and extend.
